verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā sujāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
verses.english: Then Venerable Sujāta went to see the Buddha.

verses.pali: Addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṁ sujātaṁ dūratova āgacchantaṁ.
verses.english: The Buddha saw him coming off in the distance,

verses.pali: yañca abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato, yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṁ brahmacariyapariyosānaṁ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.
verses.english: He’s attractive, good-looking, lovely, of surpassing beauty. And he has realized the supreme end of the spiritual path in this very life. He lives having achieved with his own insight the goal for which gentlemen rightly go forth from the lay life to homelessness.”
That is what the Buddha said.
Then the Holy One, the Teacher, went on to say:
having vanquished Māra with his legions.”
